name: search_live_jobs
description: Search US jobs that are live right now on employers' own careers sites (re-read on a schedule, retired within about 36 hours of leaving). Give what (title or keywords) and where (City, ST or ZIP), or remote_only.

arguments.name: min_pay
arguments.desc: Minimum pay: annual, or hourly if under 300.

arguments.name: title_exclude
arguments.desc: Comma-separated words; jobs whose title contains any of them are left out, e.g.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: 25 jobs a page; pass next_page from the previous result

name: get_job
description: The whole posting text from the employer, its requirement facts (education, licences, years required and preferred, skills), pay, any sign-on bonus it offers (the amount, quoted from the posting), benefits, whether it is still open, and the apply link.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: VeritaHire job id, as returned in search results

name: save_search
description: Sends one email to the person's own address. Their click starts a daily email of new jobs matching this search (still live on employers' own careers sites) and creates their free VeritaHire account if needed.

name: report_problem
description: Records a problem with VeritaHire data: a job listed as open that the employer's site shows closed (job_closed), wrong place, wrong pay, wrong employer name, a search that returned irrelevant results or missed jobs it should have found, or duplicates. job_id identifies one job; search holds the search arguments for a results problem.

arguments.name: detail
arguments.desc: What was wrong, in a sentence or two

arguments.name: search
arguments.desc: The search arguments that produced the problem

name: benchmark_role
description: Competitive Hiring Report, free summary, for the employer of one US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing job posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, bankers, software engineers, data roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, recruiters, marketers) that is not filling: the posted pay range in that market (salary benchmarking) and how many employers are hiring it. The full report, first one free (request_full_report), names each competitor with the pay it posts and how fast it closes the role (posting up to posting down), and shows where this posting sits and how hard the role is to fill there.

arguments.name: job_url
arguments.desc: The posting's URL on the employer's careers site, or a veritahire.com/j/ URL

name: request_full_report
description: Emails the full Competitive Hiring Report for a posting to the person who will use it (their work email). Their click creates a free VeritaHire account and opens the report.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The email address the report goes to

name: is_job_still_open
description: Checks whether a job posting is still on the employer's own careers site (VeritaHire re-reads employer sites and marks a posting closed within about 36 hours of it leaving). Returns open, closed or unknown, with the last time it was confirmed.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: The posting URL (careers site or veritahire.com/j/)
